reproduction.expected: ChatGPT, Codex, or another trusted Host can drive the existing StarterHostOrchestrator through one versioned closed command transport and the canonical root CLI without importing controller internals or inventing transition order.
reproduction.actual: The durable Orchestrator exists, but skillctl has no Host command and the repository publishes no closed command/response protocol. Each Host wrapper would have to import Python internals and independently map commands to transitions, creating inconsistent validation and authority risks.

violated_invariants: All supported Hosts must enter the same host-independent control plane.
Transport must preserve exact revisions, evidence, and wait correlation without becoming execution authority.
Natural-language interpretation must select only from verified candidates and must not become a repository keyword router.
A Host entrypoint must not grant write, completion, release, or merge authority.
